title: Material Blend 3-Mix Duo #23 (세로 띠·물결 / 부채꼴·매끈 | 나비날개비늘+이레즈미+UV네온 / 석재+나비날개비늘+뱀비늘)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 30s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, silver-white locs cascading to her waist — her body carries 3 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 vertical bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 43% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 65% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD scale formations, VIVID GOLD scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, hannya mask formations in CRIMSON and STARK GOLD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 3 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it carries UV-reactive neon bodypaint, invisible under standard light but jellyfish bioluminescence formations in ELECTRIC CYAN and MAGENTA glowing at full intensity under her own dedicated UV blacklight. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: standing full height, both arms slightly spread commanding the frame, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed. A standard hard key light illuminates most of her body; a separate dedicated UV blacklight illuminates the UV-reactive region specifically, making it glow at full intensity while the rest reads under normal light.
#1: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

#2: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 40s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, silver-white natural hair swept into a high sculpted crown — her body carries 3 different materials at once, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 42% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 3 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 7 o'clock, 12 o'clock and 4 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 7 o'clock ray and the 12 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries solid polished rose-quartz stone fused directly into her own form, soft natural veining flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING soft pink stone surface with VIVID white vein striations. Region 2 is the wedge between the 12 o'clock ray and the 4 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET scale formations, VIVID MAGENTA scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the wedge between the 4 o'clock ray and the 7 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING WARM BRONZE scale formations, VIVID BLACK scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
#2: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever region that hand falls in.

Environment: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient.
All: Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. CRITICAL: all 2 women's legs must show FULL BODY ART coverage from hip to ankle to toe with NO bare untattooed skin visible anywhere. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. 8K portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
